com.esignal.jstandard.event

Class HistoricalTickEvent<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.EventObject
      • com.esignal.jstandard.event.StatusEvent
        • com.esignal.jstandard.event.SymbolEvent
          • com.esignal.jstandard.event.TickEvent
            • com.esignal.jstandard.event.HistoricalTickEvent<T>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TurnAroundAware, java.io.Serializable

    public class HistoricalTickEvent<T>
extends TickEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalTickEvent related data.

    The listener will process this event calling the getHistoricalBarList(). Call getSymbol method for which the data is returned as a list.

    It also contains the List object with at least one historical data value on it. Please read more on HistoricalTickRecord, HistoricalTickRecordCID and HistoricalBar. Also, it is client's responsibility to identify the type of record object e.g. Quote/Trade. Requested and Complete event are just for the status purposes. Only on***Response events will contain list of objects, which will contain appropriate information depending on the HistoricalTickRequest.

    Since:
    01-001-0010
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
